title: LuthorSQL: A One-Pass Text-to-SQL Model as System 1 for a Slower LLM Agent
abstract: arXiv:2611.17780v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier LLM agents that query databases with tools are among the most accurate text-to-SQL systems, but per-query calls to a hosted model are slow, costly, and expose sensitive organizational queries to external APIs. For example, a Claude Opus 5.5 agent serving 10,000 queries a day costs over $70,000 a year at list price. To what extent can local hardware already owned by an organization offload this burden without compromising the agent's accuracy? We present LuthorSQL, a non-autoregressive 7B text-to-SQL model that serves as a rapid System 1 gate for a slower LLM agent (System 2), escalating queries only when uncertain. LuthorSQL makes a single forward pass to predict slot scores over a bounded grammar for query plans, compiles and runs up to 32 candidate plans, and chooses an answer using a trained validator. On its own, LuthorSQL reaches 68.03% execution accuracy on BIRD's hidden test set at 0.84 s per question on a single GPU, m

translated_title: LuthorSQL：作为较慢 LLM 智能体的“系统 1”的单遍文本到 SQL 模型
translated_abstract: 使用工具查询数据库的前沿 LLM 智能体是目前最准确的文本到 SQL 系统之一，但每次查询调用托管模型速度慢、成本高，且会将组织的敏感查询暴露给外部 API。例如，一个每天处理 10,000 次查询的 Claude Opus 5.5 智能体，按标价计算每年成本超过 70,000 美元。那么，组织已有的本地硬件能在多大程度上卸载这一负担而不损害智能体的准确性？我们提出了 LuthorSQL，一个非自回归的 7B 文本到 SQL 模型，它作为较慢 LLM 智能体（系统 2）的快速“系统 1”门控，仅在不确定时才将查询升级给智能体。LuthorSQL 通过单次前向传播，在受限文法上预测查询计划的槽位分数，编译并运行最多 32 个候选计划，并使用训练好的验证器选出答案。仅凭自身，LuthorSQL 在 BIRD 隐藏测试集上达到 68.03% 的执行准确率，在单个 GPU 上每个问题仅需 0.84 秒。
tldr: 提出非自回归 7B 模型 LuthorSQL，作为 LLM 智能体的快速“系统 1”门控，在单 GPU 上每题 0.84 秒即达到 BIRD 测试集 68.03% 的执行准确率，仅在不确定时才将查询升级给较慢的智能体，从而大幅降低成本并保护数据隐私。
en_tdlr: LuthorSQL is a non-autoregressive 7B text-to-SQL model that acts as a fast "System 1" gate for slower LLM agents, achieving 68.03% execution accuracy on BIRD at 0.84s per question on a single GPU while escalating only uncertain queries, dramatically reducing cost and protecting data privacy.
